# Bumper's Quest

## Post 11596 by Mrkrissatan (Patch Note Conspiracy Theorist) — 2021-08-10T21:38:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=11596#p11596 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

So you've stumbled across a Tauren NPC hidden away in southern Kalimdor named Bumper (this is my dad, he played AV so much he was listed on thottbot as a rare NPC) this is my idea for a quest chain for him.

it all starts with finding a world drop for this item [Frozen Elf Ear Necklace](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

which begins this quest:

[Heroes of Old](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

which then leads to:

[A True Son of Thunderbluff](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

which then leads to this quest:

[Things that go, Bumper... in the night](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

and finally:

[Against the Hammer](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

and here are the rewards

[Thunder Shank](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Storm Rod](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Lightning's Edge](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Stormbringer](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)

[Back Breaker](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!)
